death.attack.fog_suffocation.player: %1$s drowned in the fog while fleeing %2$s
fogged.configuration.airLossPerTick.tool: Air a player loses per tick, out of 300. Higher = drown faster.
fogged.configuration.allowedMobs.tooltip: Entity-type ids that may live in the murk. The 'minecraft:' namespace may be omitted.
fogged.configuration.boundary.tooltip: Where the boundary sits, how the murk behaves at it, and what it does to the world underneath. Shared by the server and its clients: gameplay, not looks.
fogged.configuration.debug.tooltip: Ways of seeing what the renderer is doing: raw views of the buffers behind the murk, a readout of its state, and whether compatibility trouble is logged.
fogged.configuration.debugHud.tooltip: Draw the render state (boundary, fade range, depth capture, hole count) in the corner.
fogged.configuration.debugView.tooltip: Replace the plane with a raw view of one of the buffers behind it.
fogged.configuration.depthScaling.toolti: The murk bites harder the deeper you go: air drains faster and breathing spheres shrink.
How many blocks below the boundary make up one step of scaling. 0 disables it.
fogged.configuration.depthScalingPercent: Per step: air loss up by this percent, nozzle-filter sphere radius down by it. Steps compound.
fogged.configuration.dither.tooltip: The pixel dither: how the plane thins out around the camera, and the grain of every dithered edge. Under an Iris shader pack this is also how the whole murk is drawn.
fogged.configuration.ditherPixelSize.too: Screen pixels per dither cell. 1 is a fine screen-door; larger is chunkier, closer to the foam's look.
fogged.configuration.enableExtinguish.to: The murk puts fire out under the boundary: fires vanish, lava freezes, torches fall, and the devices below are unlit and emptied of fuel.
fogged.configuration.enableScour.tooltip: The murk takes things out under the boundary: everything in the list below, broken without drops, and farmland, which reverts and loses what was planted on it.
fogged.configuration.enableTransforms.to: Master switch for the transform list. Off, the murk changes nothing into anything and JEI stops listing the conversions; the list itself is kept.
Master switch over everything the murk does to blocks and items below the boundary: putting fire out, taking things, turning them into other things. Off leaves the world exactly as it was built.
fogged.configuration.flipFog.tooltip: Put the murk above the boundary instead of below it. Does not move the breathing boundary.
fogged.configuration.foamColor.tooltip: Colour of the foam ring around everything crossing the surface. Alpha scales how strongly it shows.
fogged.configuration.foamReach.tooltip: How far above and below the plane something still raises foam. Full strength at the plane, fading to nothing at this distance. 0 restricts the foam to what the plane actually cuts through. The plane sits at a fractional height in its block row, so a reach under about 0.65 never reaches the row below it.
fogged.configuration.foamWidth.tooltip: How far the foam reaches (in blocks) from every edge. 0 disables it.
fogged.configuration.fogDistance.tooltip: How far you can see (in blocks) once the camera is under the boundary. Lower = denser murk.
fogged.configuration.fogStartRaise.toolt: Where the murk begins, from the plane: above it, 0 at it, or below it.
fogged.configuration.generatePillars.too: Raise groups of stone towers from bedrock towards the murk's high-water mark.
fogged.configuration.group.murkActions.t: Three switches over everything the murk does to blocks and items, each one governing the list of the same name below.
fogged.configuration.itemTransforms.tool: "from=to" swaps for dropped items, by item id. All of them are listed in JEI.
fogged.configuration.layout.tooltip: Where the groups stand and how often you meet them.
fogged.configuration.logRenderCompatWarn: Log once when this mod detects it cannot work with the current rendering setup.
fogged.configuration.mobEscape.tooltip: Suffocating mobs run for the nearest breathing sphere, or climb towards the boundary.
fogged.configuration.mobSpawnsInBreathin: Nozzle-filter spheres are exempt from the spawn ban: mobs spawn inside them as they would above the boundary.
Damage dealt each second once the delay is up. 2.0 = one heart.
fogged.configuration.mobSuffocateDelaySe: Seconds a non-allowed mob survives in the murk before it starts taking damage.
fogged.configuration.mobSuffocation.tool: Non-allowed mobs cannot spawn in the murk and take damage once they linger there.
fogged.configuration.murkColdness.toolti: With Cold Sweat: how much colder it is for a player under the boundary, as the share of the world's warmth the murk takes away. Warmth is the world temperature's margin above Cold Sweat's minimum habitable temperature, so a sixth takes a sixth of that -- always colder, never below where the world already was. 0 leaves the temperature alone. Does nothing without that mod.
fogged.configuration.murkDarkness.toolti: The surface's shadow: how much darker the world under the boundary is drawn, by how deep under it each thing lies, from either side. 0 leaves the lighting alone.
fogged.configuration.murkThirstScale.too: With Thirst Was Taken: how fast a player under the boundary loses water, as a share of the usual rate. The murk is a wet place; 0.25 is a quarter of the usual thirst. 1 leaves thirst alone. Does nothing without that mod.
fogged.configuration.nearDitherEnd.toolt: Beyond this many blocks the plane is solid again.
fogged.configuration.nearDitherMinVisibi: How much of the plane is left right at the camera: 0 opens it fully, 1 never thins it.
fogged.configuration.nearDitherStart.too: Inside this many blocks of the camera the plane is thinned all the way to its minimum visibility.
fogged.configuration.overdayOffsetMidnig: Height added to the schedule at midnight -- the high point of the daily rise and fall.
fogged.configuration.overdayOffsetNoon.t: Height added to the schedule at noon -- the low point of the daily rise and fall.
fogged.configuration.pillarBaseErosion.t: How far the scree skirt spreads where a tower meets the ground, so it runs into the landscape instead of being stamped through it.
fogged.configuration.pillarBlock.tooltip: Block id the towers are built from. Falls back to stone if the id names nothing.
fogged.configuration.pillarClimate.toolt: Snow and icicles on cold towers, leaves and vines and bushes on warm wet ones, grass on the rest.
fogged.configuration.pillarDensity.toolt: How thickly a cluster packs its isles. Ridges ignore this -- a crest is continuous.
fogged.configuration.pillarGreenery.tool: Grass the level ground on a tower -- its cap and its shelves -- and scatter foliage over it. Sheer faces stay bare.
fogged.configuration.pillarGreeneryDepth: How far below the murk's high-water mark greenery still grows. Deeper shelves are left bare.
Average distance in blocks between one group of towers and the next. Higher means you meet them far less often.
fogged.configuration.pillarIsleRadius.to: How far from its middle a cluster scatters its isles, in blocks.
fogged.configuration.pillarLedges.toolti: Most flat benches a tower may carry on its flanks. These are what greenery grows on.
fogged.configuration.pillarRadiusMax.too: Radius in blocks of the thickest tower.
fogged.configuration.pillarRadiusMin.too: Radius in blocks of the thinnest tower.
fogged.configuration.pillarRidgeChance.t: Share of groups that string their towers along one line, as a ridge, instead of scattering them as a cluster of isles.
fogged.configuration.pillarRidgeLengthMa: Longest a ridge may run, in blocks. A ridge may be longer than the spacing between groups.
fogged.configuration.pillarRidgeLengthMi: Shortest a ridge may run, end to end, in blocks.
fogged.configuration.pillarSpawnGroup.to: Always place one group within a hundred blocks of the world origin, however rare they are set to be elsewhere.
fogged.configuration.pillarStoneBands.to: Band the towers with granite, diorite, andesite, tuff and deepslate. The beds roll, dip and thin out rather than running as stripes.
fogged.configuration.pillarTilt.tooltip: Greatest lean off vertical, in degrees. Each tower leans a random amount up to this.
fogged.configuration.pillarTopVariance.t: How far a tower's top may fall either side of the murk's high-water mark, in blocks.
fogged.configuration.pillars.tooltip: Stone towers raised from bedrock to around the murk's high-water mark, in groups. Worldgen: changes here only reach chunks generated afterwards.
fogged.configuration.plane.tooltip: The murk's visible surface: its colour, the foam along its waterline, and how it meets the blocks that cross it. Yours alone; a server cannot dictate it.
fogged.configuration.planeColor.tooltip: Colour of the murk surface. Its alpha is ignored -- the plane always draws opaque.
fogged.configuration.planeHeightCycle.to: Loop the schedule back and forth instead of holding the last height forever.
fogged.configuration.planeHeightSchedule: One "day=height" entry per line; the boundary eases between them as the days pass.
fogged.configuration.planeNearDither.too: Dissolve the plane into a pixel dither as the camera comes close, so the surface opens up around the eye instead of snapping in as a hard sheet when the head crosses it.
Dissolve the plane against blocks, mobs, machines and flowing water instead of cutting them hard at the boundary, and open a soft disc around each entity crossing it. Experimental, and off by default: it reads the scene's depth buffer, which other rendering mods can move or replace. Turn it back off first if the murk looks wrong.
fogged.configuration.playerSuffocation.t: Players drown under the boundary: air drains, then drowning damage.
fogged.configuration.renderPlane.tooltip: Draw the murk surface at the breathing boundary.
fogged.configuration.sableFoam.tooltip: Also ring Sable ships and contraptions with foam. No effect without Sable installed.
fogged.configuration.scouredBlocks.toolt:
Extra blocks the murk breaks under the boundary, on top of the built-in scour. Broken without drops.
One block id per entry; '*' matches any run of characters and a leading '#' names a block tag. 'minecraft:' may be left off.
cobweb
#minecraft:banners
create:*_casing
fogged.configuration.shape.tooltip: What one tower is built out of, and the range of builds a group draws from.
fogged.configuration.snuffedDevices.tool:
Fire-burning devices the murk puts out: each is unlit, its burn timer zeroed and its fuel ejected, so it cannot keep running under the fog.
One block id per entry; '*' matches any run of characters and 'minecraft:' may be left off. An entry for a mod you do not have is simply ignored.
furnace
create:lit_blaze_burner
simulated:*_portable_engine
cold_sweat:hearth_bottom
fogged.configuration.suffocation.tooltip: What the murk does to the things breathing in it -- players and mobs -- and how much worse that gets with depth.
fogged.configuration.surface.tooltip: Everything laid over the bare rock: its bedding, the scree at its foot, and what grows or freezes on it.
fogged.configuration.title: Fogged Configs
fogged.configuration.transforms.tooltip:
What the murk turns things into under the boundary -- placed blocks and dropped stacks alike, from one list.
Syntax: [count] from = [count] to [@depth] [!silent]
from: a block id, an item id, an id with '*' wildcards, or a '#' tag. 'minecraft:' may be left off.
to: one id. A BLOCK replaces a placed block and keeps the properties they share; an ITEM breaks it and drops instead.
count: how many a dropped stack gives up, and how many it gets back. 1 to 64. Counts are about stacks: an entry with one does not touch placed blocks, unless it is the number of items a broken block drops.
@depth: only this far below the surface, in blocks. Moves with the boundary. 0 to 512.
!silent: keep it out of JEI. Everything else is listed there.
coal_ore=stone !silent
moss_block=coarse_dirt @50
4 diamond=2 dirt
#minecraft:leaves=1 stick !silent
create:*_casing=mud @20
fogged.configuration.vapor.tooltip: The cold-vapour layer: stacked mist sheets over the surface, terraced by a noise field so the plane never reads as dead flat.
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetBlu: Blue added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetGre: Green added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetRed: Red added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporSheets.tooltip: How many mist sheets are stacked over the plane.
fogged.configuration.vaporStrength.toolt: Overall mist alpha. 0 hides the vapour entirely.
fogged.configuration.vaporUnderside.tool: Mirror the mist sheets below the surface too, so the layer reads the same from either side.
fogged.configuration.vaporUnderwater.too: Also draw the mist before the water pass, so a lake veils it instead of it floating on top.
fogged.configuration.vaporUndulation.too: How high (in blocks) the mist sheets rise off the plane. 0 = flat.
fogged.configuration.waterlineCellsPerBl: Cells per block in the foam distance field. Lower is coarser foam and noticeably cheaper.
fogged.configuration.worldChangeSkip.too: How many blocks directly under the boundary the murk leaves alone.
fogged.tooltip.fog_detector.desc1: Emits a _redstone signal_ by how deep it sits under the fog.
fogged.tooltip.fog_detector.desc2: Right-click with _another_ to stack it taller.
fogged.tooltip.nozzle.desc1: Apply a _Wool Block_ to filter out _thick fog_.
fogged.tooltip.nozzle.desc2: An _Encased Fan's_ speed controls the _breathable area_.
